data: Apple's fiscal 2024 revenue, for the year ended September 28, 2024, was $391.0 billion ($391.035 billion). Microsoft's fiscal 2024 revenue, for the year ended June 30, 2024, was $245.1 billion ($245.122 billion). Apple's revenue was about 1.6 times Microsoft's, since $391.0 billion divided by $245.1 billion is roughly 1.60.
